summary: First iteration testing of downtime.raiders. Backend 14/14 pytest tests pass (health, score validation, sort/limit, _id exclusion, pilot uppercase+trim, persistence). Frontend e2e: start screen renders with friend logo + downtime.raiders title + NPSI footer + leaderboard; UNDOCK transitions to game canvas with HUD (Score/Wave/Lives/Bombs); player died naturally after ~48s; GameOver shows 'OH NO — GOT PIPEBOMBED! Better luck next time, capsuleer.' with score/wave/kills, submit-score-form, restart-btn, home-btn; submitting score persists to backend and the new pilot row (TEST_UIPILOT) appears in the killboard; STATION button returns to start screen.

issues: The 'Made with Emergent' badge slightly overlaps the bottom-right footer text 'FLY IT LIKE YOU STOLE IT · o7' on 1920x1080 viewport, causing the tail of the footer text to be visually clipped behind the badge. Consider adding right-padding to .dr-footer-right or hiding the tag below 1280px.

action_items: Optional: Increase right padding on .dr-footer to avoid 'Made with Emergent' badge clipping the 'FLY IT LIKE YOU STOLE IT · o7' tag at common desktop widths.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Pydantic min_length=1 lets all-whitespace pilots through model validation; the runtime strip+upper then raises 400. Acceptable, but consider adding a validator so the public contract is consistent (always 422).

server.py: max_length=24 in ScoreCreate makes the documented '24-char truncation' unreachable for clients sending >24 chars (they get 422 instead of trimmed). Either drop max_length or document the 422 behavior.
server.py: timestamp is stored as ISO string and converted back on read — works, but inconsistent with using motor's native datetime support; small cleanup opportunity.
App.js: handleSubmit silently swallows errors (only console.error). A toast on failure would improve UX since Sonner is already mounted.
GameOver.jsx: Once submitted=true the form is hidden but there is no success toast/confirmation; user only sees the leaderboard refresh after returning home.
data-testid coverage is good across StartScreen, GameOver, Leaderboard. Game.jsx HUD elements (Score/Wave/Lives/Bombs) could expose individual data-testid for more granular assertions in future.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest seeds several TEST_-prefixed scores (TEST_PILOT_ALPHA, TEST_LOW, TEST_MID, TEST_HIGH 9999, TEST_PERSIST 7,777,777, NEO 5, TEST_UIPILOT from UI submit). These remain in MongoDB scores collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_scores_api.py and run via `pytest backend/tests/test_scores_api.py -v`. JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend uses canvas + keyboard, but natural death occurs in ~45-60s of idle play (3 lives, enemies collide), which is reliable enough to validate the GameOver/submit flow without keyboard simulation. UI submitted pilot TEST_UIPILOT exists in leaderboard. Killboard top entries include TEST_PERSIST (7,777,777), TEST_HIGH (9,999), TEST_PILOT_ALPHA (1,234) — main agent can clear via mongo if needed.
